name: El Mehdi Essaadi
summary: Frontend engineer focused on React, Next.js and TypeScript, with experience leading frontend architecture and delivering consumer and agency travel products. Combines product ownership, attention to user experience and practical use of AI throughout engineering, with contributions to backend services in TypeScript and Go.

experiences.summary: Lead frontend development and architecture for consumer and agency travel platforms, from search and trip planning through checkout.
bullets: Led frontend development for an official FIFA World Cup 2026 travel booking platform, connecting matches with hotels, experiences and ground transportation.
Built Fanatrips, the company’s first B2C event travel booking frontend, with hotel, experience and car rental journeys across search, authentication, trips and payments.
Built a multi tenant white label frontend for university travel sites, with domain based branding and event content from one codebase.
Lead frontend development of Overseas Express (OX), a B2B and B2B2C platform where agencies assemble trips, book directly or share trips with travelers for checkout.
Built reusable React components with Bit.dev and a Payload CMS corporate website. Implemented Next.js caching, accessibility and multilingual interfaces including Arabic and right to left layouts.
Use Claude Code, reusable agent skills and parallel AI workflows for implementation, debugging and browser based QA. Contribute to TypeScript and Go backend services.

experiences.summary: Built commerce experiences across web and mobile, and supported the team as the frontend work grew.
bullets: Led frontend development of ftft.ma using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and GraphQL, with attention to performance and SEO.
Worked on React Native grocery picking and delivery applications, resolved mobile issues and mentored interns.

experiences.summary: Delivered React applications, browser extensions and storefront customizations for clients.
bullets: Built React interfaces and browser extensions, and customized Wix, Ecwid and Squarespace storefronts.

experiences.summary: Turned UI designs into reusable Next.js interfaces.
bullets: Translated UI designs into reusable interfaces using Next.js, Styled Components and Redux, and fixed product issues.
